Bluetooth: your AirPods' battery, where sound plays, and connecting headphones — all from Lounge.

- **Bluetooth panel.** Open the quick menu and choose Bluetooth.
- **AirPods battery.** Left, right and case battery for your AirPods (Pro, Pro 2, 3rd generation…), with charging shown. Open the AirPods case near the device if they don't appear. Windows itself doesn't show this.
- **Sound output.** See where sound plays and switch it — speakers, AirPods, a monitor — in one press.
- **Connect / disconnect.** Your paired Bluetooth headphones are listed; select one to connect or disconnect it. Pair a new device once in Windows' Bluetooth settings, and it shows up here from then on.
